description: This Java class provides assertion methods for testing and validating DittoHeaders-related objects in unit tests, ensuring they contain expected headers, schema versions, correlation IDs, and authorization subjects.

classes.name: WithDittoHeadersChecker
classes.description: A utility class for performing assertions on WithDittoHeaders objects, verifying various header properties such as presence, schema version, correlation ID, and authorization subjects.

methods.name: WithDittoHeadersChecker
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the checker with an actual WithDittoHeaders instance.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the actual object has the specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasEmptyDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the actual object has no DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasSchemaVersion
methods.description: Checks if the DittoHeaders contain the expected schema version.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Verifies that the DittoHeaders contain the expected correlation ID.

methods.name: containsAuthorizationSubject
methods.description: Asserts that the authorization context within DittoHeaders contains the specified authorization subjects.
